entities.summary: Teaterladan, officially Hedemora Gamla Theater, is a theatre and a listed building in Hedemora, Dalarna County, Sweden. It was built somewhere between 1826 and 1829 by a Hedemora wholesale dealer as a combined warehouse in the bottom two levels and theatre in the third level. The first performance at the stage was a play performed by A. P. Bergmans Sällskap on February 1, 1829. The middle level also had dressing rooms.
